C1406.title: Frosties NFT Rug Pull Fraud Case
C1406.summary: In January 2022, Ethan Nguyen and Andre Llacuna issued 8,888 Frosties NFTs and advertised future benefits including a metaverse game and giveaways. After the collection sold out and generated more than $1 million in cryptocurrency, the operators shut down the website and Discord channel, moved the proceeds to multiple wallets, and stopped fulfilling their promises. The U.S. Department of Justice later charged both men with conspiracy to commit wire fraud and money laundering.
